docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Jadunath Sarkar’s English translation of selected parts of the Caitanya-caritāmṛta of Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja, the life and teaching of Caitanya of Nadia (Calcutta, 1922). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Chaitanya's life and teachings : from his contemporary Bengali biography the Chaitanya-charit-amrita · Krshnadasa Kaviraja, b. 1518 or 1519 · 1922, 338 scanned pages. Published 1922; Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja lived in the sixteenth century and Jadunath Sarkar died 1958; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
